name: combinado
description: Combinado · Starthrop for ChatGPT: schedule, job history, clients, quotes, expenses, money to receive and hours worked for service professionals.

interface.longDescription:
Combinado is the work app for independent service professionals and small service businesses — cleaning, repairs, care, lessons and other services. Connect your Combinado account to ask about your schedule, clients, quotes, hours worked and money still to receive, by conversation.

What you can do:
- See your appointments for a day or week, including upcoming recurring visits.
- See who still owes you money, overdue first.
- Get your hours worked and money received for a day, week or month.
- Look through your full job history, by period, status or kind of work.
- See your expenses (paid or still to pay, and how you paid) and the result of a period: work done, money received, expenses and what is left.
- Prepare draft quotes, add clients, notes and task checklists.
- Reschedule an appointment or record a payment you received — always with a preview you approve first.

Limits: nothing is ever sent to your clients from ChatGPT, nothing is deleted, and Combinado never moves money (it only records what you received). Changes appear in the Combinado app at its next sync. Requires a Combinado account.
defaultPrompt: What do I have scheduled this week?
Prepare a quote for a deep cleaning of a 2-bedroom flat

positive.prompt: What do I have scheduled this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's appointments for the week in time order (clients Maria (demo), João (demo), Ana (demo)) with time, place and price; upcoming recurring visits are marked as projected.
Lists clients with an open balance, overdue first, with the amount per item and the total in EUR; amounts are never summed across currencies.

positive.prompt: How many hours did I work this month and how much did I receive?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the hours worked, jobs done, value of work done, money received and still outstanding for the current month.

positive.prompt: List the gardening jobs I did in the last 30 days and how much is still owed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's done gardening jobs of the last 30 days (João (demo)) with date, hours, what each job is worth, what was received and what is still owed, in EUR.

positive.prompt: What did I spend this month and what is my result after expenses?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo expenses (cleaning products and the monthly transport pass) with category, amount and whether each is paid or planned, then gives the month's money received, paid expenses, planned expenses and the net cash result, without mixing value of work done with money received.

positive.description: Draft quote for an existing client
positive.prompt: Prepare a quote for Maria: deep cleaning 120 euros and windows 35 euros, valid for two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a DRAFT quote for Maria (demo) with two lines and a total of €155.00; states that nothing was sent to the client.

positive.prompt: Move Ana's next appointment to the following day at 10:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview (current and new date/time and other appointments that day) and changes nothing until the user agrees; after agreement the appointment is moved and the client is not notified.

negative.description: Sending messages to clients is not supported
negative.prompt: Send the quote to Maria on WhatsApp.
Charge João's card for what he owes me.

review.commerce_description: Combinado · Starthrop for ChatGPT does not sell products, show plans or process payments. It records payments the professional received, without moving money.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: new read tools list_jobs (full job history with filters and pages) and list_expenses (expenses by period, paid or planned, with the payment method; monthly recurring ones once per month). get_period_summary accepts a custom range and an activity filter and adds paid and planned expenses and the net cash result. Every read result says which Combinado account is connected and whether it has data from the app, so an account without app data is never shown as 'no records'. The sign-in page warns when the email has no app data yet.

pt-BR.subtitle: Agenda, orçamentos e cobranças
pt-BR.description: O Combinado é o app de trabalho para profissionais autônomos e pequenas empresas de serviços. Conecte sua conta para consultar agenda, histórico de trabalhos, clientes, orçamentos, despesas, horas trabalhadas e valores a receber, preparar orçamentos em rascunho e organizar seu trabalho por conversa. Nada é enviado aos seus clientes pelo ChatGPT, nada é apagado e o Combinado nunca movimenta dinheiro. Alterar uma visita ou registrar um recebimento sempre mostra uma prévia antes.
